R1.1.title: Mobile GPU budget: scope blur >=40px to md:/lg: desktop viewports

R1.2.title: SSR visibility resilience: never leave [data-reveal] at opacity:0 without CSS animation fallback

R1.3.title: Third-party script deferral: load GTM/GA4 with lazyOnload after hydration

R1.4.title: Zero-flash theme bootstrap: paired semantic tokens across light/dark modes

R1.5.title: No dead controls: every interactive element wires a handler and loading/error feedback

R1.6.title: Accessible switch geometry: inline-flex items-center shrink-0 on toggle tracks

R1.7.title: LCP asset priority: priority/fetchpriority=high on hero LCP image, lazy below fold

R1.8.title: Async polling hygiene: clear intervals on unmount and stop polling on terminal states

R2.1.title: Tenant context derivation: derive tenant context from verified session, never client payload

R2.2.title: Tenant-scoped data access: every DB read/write filters by authenticated workspace scope

R2.3.title: Dual-key entity resolution: discriminate UUID/CUID vs domain/slug before database query

R2.4.title: Raw-body webhook verification: verify HMAC against raw request text before JSON parse

R2.5.title: Outbound SSRF & timeout guard: validate URL host and set AbortSignal.timeout()

R2.6.title: Constant-time secret comparison: use timingSafeEqual / compare_digest

R2.7.title: Secure cookie & CORS hygiene: HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite, no wildcard CORS with credentials

R2.8.title: No unsafe code or HTML sinks: no eval or new Function on strings; dangerouslySetInnerHTML only with sanitised HTML

R3.1.title: Idempotent webhook processing: deduplicate event_id with monotonic state transitions

R3.2.title: Monetary integer representation: store money as integer minor units (cents) + currency

R3.3.title: Gateway ID discrimination: validate customer/subscription/checkout prefix before API call

R3.4.title: Pre-execution quota enforcement: verify tier entitlement before paid LLM/API calls

R3.5.title: Transactional outbox: persist DB state before enqueuing external side effects

R4.1.title: Expand-contract migrations: additive nullable/default columns; no single-step drop/rename

R4.2.title: Foreign-key & tenant composite indexing: index FKs and (tenant_id, created_at)

R4.3.title: N+1 query prevention: batch queries with IN / joins instead of per-row loop queries

R4.4.title: Ingestion FK pre-resolution: upsert or verify parent workspace before child rows

R4.5.title: Bounded pagination: enforce hard LIMIT (<=100) on every list query

R5.1.title: Deterministic graceful fallbacks: return explicit degraded status, never fabricated metrics

R5.2.title: HTTP empty-body hygiene: 204 returns empty body; 200 JSON sets Content-Type

R5.3.title: Bounded retry with jitter: retry only transient 429/502/503/504 with backoff + jitter

R5.4.title: No silent exception swallowing: log or surface errors; never use empty catch blocks

R5.5.title: Process & lock safety: every subprocess.run carries timeout=; locks use try/finally

R6.1.title: Real production import gate: tests must import and invoke real production code

R6.2.title: Mutation side-effect assertions: assert persisted state or DOM changes, not just HTTP 200

R6.3.title: Deterministic condition waits: never use waitForTimeout/sleep in tests

R6.4.title: Hermetic test state isolation: isolate DB/state paths per test in setUp/addCleanup

R6.5.title: Post-incident regression crystallization: every bug fix includes a failing-first test

R7.1.title: Contract-first monorepo changes: update shared Zod/OpenAPI schema before consumers

R7.2.title: Granular field validation: return field-level errors and preserve user form inputs

R7.3.title: Single canonical route per path: no duplicate route group paths

R7.4.title: Acyclic module layering: domain -> application -> adapters; no circular imports

R7.5.title: Universal contracts purity: contracts barrels must not import Node built-ins (node:fs, node:path)

R8.1.title: Anti-cloaking & markdown parity: serve identical facts to crawlers and browsers

R8.2.title: Honest telemetry attribution: label synthetic/demo data; never mix with live metrics

R8.3.title: Consent Mode v2 ordering: initialize default denied consent before analytics tags

R9.1.title: No untyped escape hatches: no `as any` casts or `z.any()` schemas in production source

R9.2.title: No silenced type errors: no @ts-ignore; every @ts-expect-error states its reason

R9.3.title: Package-name imports: import workspace packages by name, never via ../../packages/ paths

R10.1.title: Explicit HTTP request timeouts: every fetch/axios call specifies timeout or AbortSignal

R10.2.title: Idempotency key transmission: mutating external POST/PUT requests send Idempotency-Key

R10.3.title: Rate-limit header handling: parse 429 Retry-After and respect backoff deadlines

R10.4.title: Structured error envelope: error responses adhere to standard JSON error schema

R10.5.title: Response size bounding: clamp response body reads to avoid unbounded buffer allocation

R10.6.title: Content-Type negotiation: validate incoming request Accept / Content-Type headers

R10.7.title: No unauthenticated admin endpoints: route middleware protects management routes

R10.8.title: Strict HTTP verb mapping: GET requests must be strictly read-only and side-effect free

R11.1.title: Atomic read-modify-write: concurrent mutations use compare-and-swap or row locks

R11.2.title: No dangling unawaited promises: promise chains either return or await explicitly

R11.3.title: Race condition prevention: UI mutations abort pending conflicting requests via AbortController

R11.4.title: Deterministic reducer purity: state reducers remain pure functions without side effects

R11.5.title: Cache key stability: cache keys use sorted/normalized parameters to avoid fragmentation

R11.6.title: Optimistic UI rollback: optimistic state updates retain rollback snapshot on failure

R11.7.title: Bounded in-memory queues: memory queues specify max length and overflow policy

R11.8.title: Thread-safe singleton initialization: singletons use atomic locks or double-checked init

R12.1.title: Event listener teardown: addEventListener in useEffect/components pairs with removeEventListener

R12.2.title: Timer lifecycle cleanup: setTimeout and setInterval handle IDs cleaned on component unmount

R12.3.title: Stream disposal hygiene: open readable/writable streams explicitly call close() or pipe safely

R12.4.title: WebSocket cleanup: client socket connections explicitly disconnect on navigation/unmount

R12.5.title: Database connection pool hygiene: acquired pool clients release in finally blocks

R12.6.title: Worker thread termination: spawn worker instances call terminate() upon task completion

R12.7.title: Temp file deterministic deletion: scratch files in /tmp register unlink in finalizer

R12.8.title: No unbounded collection growth: caches and registries specify TTL or LRU eviction

R13.1.title: Zero secret logging: redact passwords, tokens, API keys, and authorization headers

R13.2.title: Structured JSON logging: application logs emit valid JSON key-value pairs with timestamps

R13.3.title: Trace context propagation: distributed calls forward traceparent / correlation IDs

R13.4.title: Metric label cardinality bounding: avoid dynamic user IDs or timestamps in metric labels

R13.5.title: Standard log severity: use debug/info/warn/error appropriately without log spam

R13.6.title: Audit event journaling: security-critical actions append an immutable audit record

R13.7.title: Health check hermeticity: /healthz endpoints execute lightweight non-allocating probes

R13.8.title: Exception traceback containment: sanitize public error responses to avoid leaking paths

R14.1.title: Session token entropy: session identifiers contain at least 128 bits of cryptosecure random

R14.2.title: Password hash modern algorithms: use Argon2id or bcrypt with appropriate work factor

R14.3.title: Token expiration bounding: short-lived access tokens paired with rotating refresh tokens

R14.4.title: CSRF token validation: state-changing forms and endpoints validate anti-CSRF token

R14.5.title: No credentials in URLs: tokens, API keys, and passwords never passed in query strings

R14.6.title: Strict redirect URL allowlist: OAuth / login return URLs validated against domain allowlist

R14.7.title: Brute-force throttle: login and reset-password routes rate-limited by IP and username

R14.8.title: Role-based access control: enforce authorization check at controller/handler boundary

R15.1.title: React error boundary protection: major route segments wrapped in error boundaries

R15.2.title: Non-blocking third-party failures: external widgets render graceful placeholder on failure

R15.3.title: Form submit recovery: failed form submission preserves user input for retry

R15.4.title: Image broken state fallback: img / Image tags provide alt and error state fallback

R15.5.title: Network offline banner: offline connectivity state indicated with non-blocking alert

R15.6.title: Empty state affordance: data tables and lists display actionable empty state message

R15.7.title: Skeleton loader transition: loading states use layout-preserving skeletons to avoid CLS

R15.8.title: Recoverable 404 navigation: not-found pages provide search and home navigation links

R16.1.title: Lockfile integrity enforcement: CI installs strictly via frozen lockfiles (pnpm --frozen)

R16.2.title: No wildcard dependency versions: package.json avoids '*' or unbounded range dependencies

R16.3.title: Scoped internal packages: monorepo internal packages use scoped organization prefixes

R16.4.title: No install script execution: untrusted packages ignore postinstall lifecycle scripts

R16.5.title: Production bundle minimization: devDependencies not imported in production runtime code

R16.6.title: License compliance: no copyleft (GPL) dependencies imported into proprietary modules

R16.7.title: Single package manager: repo roots maintain exactly one package manager lockfile

R16.8.title: Deterministic engine constraints: package.json specifies minimum node/pnpm engines

R17.1.title: Server Component default: components in app directory default to RSC unless 'use client'

R17.2.title: No server-only code in client: 'server-only' imports barred from client-marked components

R17.3.title: Metadata API compliance: route pages export static or generateMetadata for SEO

R17.4.title: Next/Image usage: production UI renders next/image for optimized srcset and layout stability

R17.5.title: Next/Font optimization: load Google/local fonts via next/font with zero layout shift

R17.6.title: Client boundary minimization: push 'use client' directives down to leaf interactive nodes

R17.7.title: Server action security: server actions validate session authentication before mutating

R17.8.title: Route handler return typing: route handlers return typed NextResponse with status

R18.1.title: Meaningful image alternative text: informative images supply descriptive alt attribute

R18.2.title: Form control labels: every input, select, and textarea element has associated label

R18.3.title: Keyboard navigation accessibility: interactive elements focusable via Tab and Enter/Space

R18.4.title: Contrast ratio minimum: text satisfies 4.5:1 minimum contrast ratio against background

R18.5.title: No click handlers on non-interactive elements: divs/spans with onClick specify role='button'

R18.6.title: Aria attributes validity: aria-* attributes use valid names and permissible state values

R18.7.title: Visible focus rings: interactive elements retain visible focus outline for keyboard users

R18.8.title: Document language attribute: html root element specifies valid lang='en' attribute

R19.1.title: Function length limit: functions remain under 100 lines; extract complex branches

R19.2.title: Cyclomatic complexity bounding: functions maintain cyclomatic complexity <= 20

R19.3.title: No dead commented-out code: remove obsolete commented code blocks prior to PR merge

R19.4.title: Descriptive variable naming: avoid single-character variables outside trivial loops
